title: The 2-Minute Rule
text: If a task takes less than 2 minutes, do it right now instead of writing it down.

title: Drink Water First
text: Start every morning with a glass of water before coffee — your body dehydrates overnight.

title: One Thing At A Time
text: Multitasking can cut productivity by up to 40%. Focus on a single task until it's done.

title: The 5-Second Rule
text: Count 5-4-3-2-1 and move before your brain talks you out of the action you decided to take.

title: Power of No
text: Every yes to something unimportant is a silent no to something that matters.

title: 10-Minute Walk
text: A short daily walk boosts creativity — ideas flow better in motion than sitting down.

title: Sleep Consistency
text: Go to bed and wake up at the same time daily — consistency beats total hours for energy.

title: The 80/20 Rule
text: 80% of your results come from 20% of your efforts. Find that 20% and protect it fiercely.

title: Eat The Frog
text: Do your hardest, most important task first thing — everything after feels easier.

title: Batch Your Tasks
text: Group similar small tasks (emails, calls, errands) into one time block instead of scattering them.

title: Phone Away At Night
text: Charge your phone outside your bedroom — it removes the temptation to scroll before sleep.

title: Weekly Review
text: Spend 15 minutes every Sunday reviewing your week and planning the next one.

title: Learn In Dead Time
text: Turn commutes and chores into learning time with podcasts or audiobooks.

title: The Rule Of Three
text: Each morning, pick the 3 things that would make today a win. Ignore the rest.

title: Two-Minute Journal
text: Write down one thing you're grateful for and one thing you'll win at today. Takes 2 minutes.

title: 20-20-20 Screen Rule
text: Every 20 minutes, look at something 20 feet away for 20 seconds to rest your eyes.

title: Automate Repetition
text: Anything you do the same way twice is worth automating or templating the third time.

title: Read 10 Pages Daily
text: 10 pages a day is 12+ books a year. Small habits compound into big knowledge.

title: The Two-Day Rule
text: Never skip a good habit two days in a row. One miss is an accident; two is a new pattern.

title: Prepare Tomorrow Tonight
text: Lay out tomorrow's plan, clothes, and priorities before bed — mornings become effortless.

title: Deep Work Block
text: Block 90 distraction-free minutes daily for your most valuable work. Guard it like a meeting.

title: Reply Window
text: Check messages at set times (e.g., 12pm and 5pm) instead of reacting to every ping instantly.

title: The 1% Better Rule
text: Improve just 1% each day — in a year you'll be 37x better than where you started.

title: Sunlight Before Screens
text: Get 10 minutes of morning sunlight before touching your phone — it sets your body clock.

title: Write It Down
text: Your brain is for having ideas, not holding them. Capture everything in one trusted place.

title: The 90-Minute Cycle
text: Work in 90-minute focus blocks with real breaks between — it matches your body's energy rhythm.

title: Ask Better Questions
text: Replace 'Why does this happen to me?' with 'What can I learn from this?' — instant mindset shift.

title: Shrink The Goal
text: Can't start? Make the goal so small it's impossible to fail: one push-up, one sentence, one minute.

title: Environment Beats Willpower
text: Want fewer snacks? Don't buy them. Better habits start by changing your surroundings, not yourself.

title: The 24-Hour Rule
text: Wait 24 hours before any non-essential purchase. Most wants evaporate by morning.

title: Say It Out Loud
text: Stuck on a problem? Explain it out loud to yourself — 50% of problems dissolve when spoken.

title: Learn By Teaching
text: The fastest way to master something is to explain it to someone else in simple words.

title: One Tab Rule
text: Keep one browser tab for work at a time. Open tabs are open distractions.

title: Feedback Fast
text: Ship your work at 80% done. Feedback on real work beats perfecting work nobody has seen.

title: Move Every Hour
text: Set a timer: stand up and stretch for 2 minutes every hour of sitting. Your back will thank you.

title: The Magic Of Done
text: A finished mediocre project teaches more than a perfect one that never ships.

title: Name Your Why
text: Write one sentence on why your goal matters. Read it when motivation dips.

title: Digital Sunset
text: No screens 30-60 minutes before bed — your sleep quality jumps within a week.

title: The Five-Minute Start
text: Commit to just 5 minutes on the task you're avoiding. Starting is the hardest part — momentum does the rest.

title: Cancel One Subscription
text: Audit your subscriptions monthly — most people find at least one they forgot they had.

title: The Friendship Audit
text: Notice who leaves you energized vs. drained after meeting. Spend more time with the first group.

title: Cook Double
text: Cook once, eat twice — batch-cooking saves 5+ hours a week and keeps eating healthy easy.

title: The Clean-Desk Reset
text: Clear your desk at the end of each day — you'll start tomorrow without yesterday's clutter.

title: Breath Reset
text: Stressed? Breathe in 4 seconds, hold 4, out 8. Repeat 3 times. It's a system reset button.

title: Single-Task Chores
text: Use chores as mental breaks — wash dishes mindfully instead of doom-scrolling in between tasks.

title: Track One Habit
text: Don't track 10 habits. Track one, nail it for 30 days, then add the next.

title: The Birthday Rule
text: Write birthday reminders with a one-line memory of the person — messages become personal, not automated.

title: Silence Notifications
text: Turn off all non-human notifications. If it's not a person, it can wait until you check.

title: Weekly Digital Detox
text: Pick 2 hours weekly with no screens. Read, walk, cook — remember what your brain feels like unplugged.

title: The 3-Note System
text: Keep only 3 daily notes: what worked, what didn't, and the one thing to do differently tomorrow.

title: Ask For It
text: Most opportunities are lost to silence, not rejection. Ask the question, send the email, make the call.

title: Ten Minutes Tidy
text: Set a 10-minute timer and tidy one room nightly. Clutter never builds up to overwhelming.

title: Learn Names Fast
text: Repeat a new person's name once in your first conversation — you'll remember it for years.

title: The Pillow Rule
text: Never make important decisions when you're hungry, angry, or tired. Sleep first, decide after.

title: Money Dates
text: Book 30 minutes weekly to review spending and savings. Money surprises shrink fast.

title: Zero-Inbox Trigger
text: Every time you open your inbox, process what's there: reply, delete, or file — never just look.

title: The Two-List Method
text: One list for the week, one for today. Anything that sits on today's list 3 days moves to the week list.

title: Skill Stacking
text: You don't need to be world-class at one thing — being good at 2-3 rare-together skills beats everyone.

title: Parkinson's Law Breaker
text: Give a task a tight deadline and it shrinks to fit. Give it a day and it takes a day.

title: Micro-Reward Wins
text: Celebrate small wins out loud — your brain repeats what gets rewarded.
